verdict.rationale: Grafana runs several kinds of rule-based automation in the background. Alert rules are continuously evaluated and notify Slack or PagerDuty (grafana-gh-7, grafana-docs-24), on-call escalation routes alerts to whoever is on call (grafana-docs-6), and recording rules generate new data (grafana-docs-34). Grafana Cloud also runs AI-flavoured background processes: Knowledge Graph continuously generates insights (grafana-docs-59) and Adaptive Telemetry automatically aggregates data (grafana-docs-28). However, there is no evidence that users can define their own AI-driven autonomous agents or workflows; AI features such as Assistant and Investigations are only named (grafana-docs-45). Missing for 10: user-configurable autonomous AI agent or workflow automations, docs on scheduling or triggering AI tasks in the background, and hands-on corroboration of autonomous AI behavior.
